title: NPC scripts (GameData/NpcScripts/*.json): a program and its bindings, or a .bindings.json file.
description: Hand-maintained next to ZoneEngine_New/Core/NpcScripts/NpcScriptCompiler.cs, which is the authority; the compiler reports anything this schema lets through. Design: docs/architecture/NPC_SCRIPTING_DESIGN.md.

Id.description: Program id, unique over the folder. Bindings files name it in Script.

Script.description: Bindings file only (<name>.bindings.json): the program these bindings run.

Params.description: Parameters every binding must supply in Args, by name. Ops refer to them as $Name; Vector3[] params as $Name[i] or $Name[next].

range.description: A fixed number or [min, max], picked evenly.

socialAction.description: A SocialAction enum name (full or its short tail, e.g. Shrug for GesturesShrug), an id 1..71, or a $SocialAction param.

gfxId.description: A gfx template id (never 49999), or a $Gfx param. The template's category must match the anchor: character-anchored (On Self) or position-anchored (At, Offset, From/To).

movePoint.description: [x, y, z], "Home", "$Vector3Param", "$Vector3ArrayParam[i]" or "$Vector3ArrayParam[next]" (advances the NPC's waypoint cursor).

moveTarget.description: A move point, or { "To": point, "Direct": true } to walk the straight line without the navmesh: a bridge across a short gap the mesh does not cover, such as a ramp between two mesh islands.

Direct.description: Walk straight to the point, ignoring the navmesh.

Label.description: A Goto / If target within this handler.

Wait.description: Blocking delay in ms, at least 100.

WalkTo.description: Blocking walk at walking pace; raises Arrived or Stuck.

RunTo.description: Blocking walk at running pace; raises Arrived or Stuck.

Emote.description: Plays a social animation from the NPC and blocks for its duration (default 2000 ms).

Say.description: Vicinity chat from the NPC (rate limited to one line per second). Text may be a $Text param.

Item.description: An item hash or a $ItemHash param.

Gfx.description: GfxTrigger to the NPC's observers. A bare id plays on the NPC (type 2).

On.description: With At: type 4 (bound to the NPC at a position).

Offset.description: Type 1 at the NPC's position plus this.

From.description: With To: type 3 between two positions.

Despawn.description: The NPC leaves the world as a GM despawn would.

If.description: Jumps to Goto when the condition holds. One of: Var with Eq/Ne/Lt/Gt, HealthBelow, HasTarget, Chance.

Random.description: Runs one of the blocks, picked evenly.

Restart.description: Ends this handler and starts the first handler of that trigger.

ReleaseMovement.description: Gives movement back to patrol / wander / idle.

SetHome.description: Re-posts the NPC: "Here" (its current position) or a move point becomes its home for leashing and returning, so a long march does not leash back to its spawn once it ends. While a WalkTo/RunTo is under way the NPC already leashes from the walk's target rather than its spawn.

Percent.description: HealthBelow: fires once per life when health drops to this percent or below.

Waypoint.description: Arrived / Stuck: only this waypoint index; omit for any.

NanoId.description: NanoEnded: only this nano; omit or 0 for any.

EveryMs.description: Timer: period in ms (at least 100), re-armed after each run.

Interrupts.description: Preempts a running handler (which resumes afterwards) instead of being dropped.

Priority.description: Among handlers of the same trigger, higher is tried first.

binding.description: Exactly one target: Hash (every NPC of that template, optionally on one Playfield), SpawnPoint (HASH@x,y,z[#n], needs Playfield) or NpcKey (a PlayfieldContent Npcs.json Key, needs Playfield).

Args.description: One value per program Param: Vector3[] as [[x,y,z], ...], Vector3 as [x,y,z], ItemHash and Text as strings, SocialAction as name or id, Int and Gfx as integers.

Movement.description: Plain movement without a program (or alongside one): the brain's existing patrol or wander.

Provenance.description: Where the data came from, e.g. capture:<who> <date>.
